items.exampleEn: I wear sandals at the beach in summer.
items.exampleZh: 夏天去海邊時我穿涼鞋。

items.exampleEn: She gave me a clean handkerchief when I started to cry.
items.exampleZh: 我開始哭的時候，她給了我一條乾淨的手帕。

items.exampleEn: This stylish bag was made by a local designer.
items.exampleZh: 這個有型的包包是當地設計師做的。

items.exampleEn: My grandmother knitted this jumper for me.
items.exampleZh: 這件毛衣是奶奶為我織的。

items.exampleEn: The puppy has short, curly hair.
items.exampleZh: 那隻小狗有一身短短的捲毛。

items.exampleEn: The old sofa is worn and needs to be replaced.
items.exampleZh: 那張舊沙發已經磨損，需要換掉了。

items.exampleEn: I always wear a sweatshirt when I go running.
items.exampleZh: 我去跑步時總是穿運動衫。

items.exampleEn: He was too tired to undress, so he slept in his clothes.
items.exampleZh: 他累得連衣服都不想脫，就穿著衣服睡了。

items.sentenceEn: She has long, curly hair like her mother.
items.sentenceZh: 她和她媽媽一樣有一頭長長的捲髮。

items.audioEn: These sandals are on sale for ten dollars, so I bought two pairs.
items.audioZh: 這雙涼鞋特價十元，所以我買了兩雙。

items.sentenceEn: His old jeans are worn at the knees.
items.sentenceZh: 他的舊牛仔褲膝蓋的地方磨破了。

items.sentenceEn: My grandfather always carries a handkerchief in his pocket.
items.sentenceZh: 我爺爺口袋裡總是帶著一條手帕。

items.stemEn: Her new haircut is short and ____.
items.stemZh: 她的新髮型短短的，很有型。

items.stemEn: It's cold today, so put on a warm ____.
items.stemZh: 今天很冷，穿件保暖的毛衣吧。

items.passageEn: Our school has a new rule: on Fridays, students can wear casual clothes. My friend Tina loves it. Last Friday, she wore a gray sweatshirt, worn jeans, and white sandals. Her curly hair was tied up with a red handkerchief. Everyone said she looked stylish. But the weather turned cold in the afternoon, and she had to borrow a jumper from me.
items.passageZh: 我們學校有一條新規定：星期五學生可以穿便服。我的朋友 Tina 很喜歡。上星期五，她穿了一件灰色運動衫、一條舊牛仔褲和一雙白色涼鞋。她的捲髮用一條紅色手帕綁了起來。大家都說她很有型。不過下午天氣變冷，她只好跟我借了一件毛衣。

questions.questionZh: 下午 Tina 為什麼跟作者借毛衣？

items.promptZh: 洗澡前先幫寶寶脫衣服。
referenceEn: Undress the baby before her bath.
Undress the baby before you give her a bath.
rubricZh: undress 表示「（替人）脫衣服」，後面可接人
寫 take off the baby's clothes 意思也正確
祈使句用原形動詞開頭

items.promptZh: 這家咖啡店裡面布置得很時髦。
referenceEn: The inside of this cafe is very stylish.
This cafe looks very stylish inside.
rubricZh: 用 stylish 表示「時髦的；有型的」（例如 very stylish）
